description: This file defines the SimpleJobNameProvider class, which implements the JobNameProvider interface to supply a set of job names encapsulated in JobNameData objects. It includes a constructor that initializes the set of job names from a collection and a provide() method that returns this set.

classes.name: SimpleJobNameProvider
classes.description: Implements JobNameProvider to supply a set of job name data objects, initialized via constructor.

methods.name: SimpleJobNameProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the set of job names from the given collection.

methods.name: provide
methods.description: Returns the set of JobNameData objects representing available job names.
